rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thank you for reaching out. I appreciate your interest in Halcyon Threshold. Unfortunately, I'm not in a position to provide an on-the-record quote at this time. I hope to be able to speak more publicly about this work soon, and I'd be happy to reconnect when that's possible. Best of luck with your piece. Morgan"
rows.quote: **Declined** reporter quote request (Tessa Brandt, Larkin Dispatch)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Dear Corvid Institute, Thank you for the invitation to sign on to the open letter on frontier training runs. I appreciate the work you're doing on AI governance. I'm not able to add my name as a public signatory at this time due to current constraints, but I support thoughtful efforts in this space and hope to be more visibly involved in the future. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much — this means a lot. Having someone with data analysis skills offering to help is exactly the kind of thing I was hoping might come out of the meetup. I'm still sorting out the direction for Halcyon Threshold, but I'd love to find something concrete for you to work on. A few possibilities I've been thinking about: 1. Landscape mapping — helping identify what's neglected in the AI safety/governance space that a small organization could realistically tackle 2. Evaluations research — there may be important things about AI systems that nobody is measuring 3. Grant/funding analysis — understanding who funds what in this space Would any of these interest you? Or if you have ideas based on your own sense of what's needed, I'm very open to hearing them. Let's find a time to talk if that's easier than email. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: **Responded warmly** to Priya Raman's volunteer offer — suggested landscape mapping, evals research, or funding analysis
